findings.message:
Reentrancy in EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (../sb/etherstore.sol#20-30):
	External calls:
	- require(bool)(msg.sender.call.value(_weiToWithdraw)()) (../sb/etherstore.sol#27)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _weiToWithdraw (../sb/etherstore.sol#28)
	EtherStore.balances (../sb/etherstore.sol#14) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherStore.balances (../sb/etherstore.sol#14)
	- EtherStore.depositFunds() (../sb/etherstore.sol#16-18)
	- EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (../sb/etherstore.sol#20-30)
	- lastWithdrawTime[msg.sender] = now (../sb/etherstore.sol#29)
	EtherStore.lastWithdrawTime (../sb/etherstore.sol#13) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherStore.lastWithdrawTime (../sb/etherstore.sol#13)
	- EtherStore.withdrawFunds(uint256) (../sb/etherstore.sol#20-30)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
